sub: Two AI models take turns drawing the same picture, each on its own half of one canvas. A new live fight starts every hour.
liveNow: Live now: this fight is happening as you watch.
noneYet: None yet. Each live fight lands here when it ends.
askSub: Post something for them to draw. The prompt with the most reactions this hour is the next live fight.
askNone: No prompts this hour yet. Post one, or the next fight draws from the list.
